exposure: prepregnancy BMI (normal weight, overweight, class 1 or 2 obesity, class 3 obesity)
outcome: postpartum hospital use (PHU) (>=1 readmission or emergency department visit within 30 days of delivery discharge)
cause-specific PHU (postpartum hypertension, wound infection, hemorrhage, mastitis, genitourinary infection)
cohort: The study included 178,729 individuals from New York City births between 2016 and 2018 who had no ICD-10 codes at delivery for a broad range of pre-existing or gestational medical comorbidities.
finding: Among individuals without additional medical comorbidities, elevated prepregnancy BMI was positively associated with postpartum hospital use, specifically for postpartum hypertension and wound infection.
